invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.0905且RSI跌破45，或融资费率Z-score回落至100%以下（过热缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.0905 with RSI falling below 45, or funding rate Z-score drops below 100% (overheating eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$68500且融资费率Z-score回升至-20%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势恶化（跌破关键支撑$68000）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $68500 with funding Z-score rising above -20% (short pressure eases), or daily trend worsens (breaking key support $68000).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$1980且RSI跌破50，或融资费率Z-score升至100%以上（转为过热），或日线趋势进一步恶化。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $1980 with RSI falling below 50, or funding Z-score rises above 100% (becomes overheated), or daily trend worsens further.
